headline: Ganga Forging Limited announces rights issue of equity shares at ₹1.63 per share in 3:2 ratio
sum: Ganga Forging Limited's board approved a rights issue of equity shares in a 3:2 ratio (3 new shares for every 2 held) at ₹1.63 per share. The announcement was made via NSE filing on 25 June 2026.
detail: Ganga Forging Limited's Board of Directors at its meeting on 25 June 2026 decided to issue equity shares on a rights basis at ₹1.63 per share in a 3:2 ratio. The rights offering is a common equity-dilution mechanism under the Companies Act 2013 and SEBI ICDR Regulations to raise capital without external issuance. The exact quantum of shares and total capital to be raised was not disclosed in the NSE filing excerpt; further disclosure would typically follow in the letter of offer and shareholder approval filings.
